sentences.en: He will have gotten the inspiration from that animated cartoon.
sentences.zh: 他从那部动画片中获得了灵感。

sentences.en: My mother was an angel and an inspiration to me.
sentences.zh: 我的妈妈是个天使，也是我一生中的鼓舞。

sentences.en: Algeria would sure give Homer an inspiration for a poem.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚肯定会给荷马提供写诗的灵感。

senses.zh: 灵感,鼓舞人心的人或事,启发灵感的人（或事物）,吸气
